recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. FHIR-13357 needs no follow-up unless a future work group decision reopens DataRequirement date filter semantics; FHIR-53984 should be handled separately if that valueFilter issue enters reconciliation scope.
issue_request: FHIR-13357 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request for DataRequirement.dateFilter.value[x]. It asked that a Duration-valued date filter be clarified to mean the interval before now, (now-duration, now), rather than a future interval, and the resolution agreed to update the definition as suggested.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was applied at SVN 12597. In the migrated git history, commit 7fb1cda389a347eb0d7908d8f0d9fd8e82d1075a has message "#13357: Clarified semantics of duration-valued filters in DataRequirement" and git-svn-id build@12597, and it changed the DataRequirement spreadsheet wording from "Duration from now" to "Duration before now".
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists DataRequirement as an active datatype, maps datarequirement to the metadatatypes page, marks DataRequirement normative, and assigns its TLA, so source/datatypes/datarequirement.xml is in current build scope. Bounded Jira searching found FHIR-53984, but that later Resolved - change required R6 issue concerns DataRequirement.valueFilter.value[x], not the dateFilter Duration semantics. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting work-group or community record beyond the original tracker notification.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/datatypes/datarequirement.xml already defines DataRequirement.dateFilter.value[x] as dateTime|Period|Duration and says that when a Duration is specified, the filter returns data items within Duration before now. A search outside historical snapshots found no active source still using the old future-looking phrasing.

related_jiras.note: Later R6 Resolved - change required issue found by the bounded search; it concerns DataRequirement.valueFilter.value[x], not DataRequirement.dateFilter.value[x] Duration semantics, so it was not decided here.
